meta.title: Small-area population estimates by age (LSOA 2021)
meta.next_update: Autumn each year (next mid-year release c. Nov 2026 - check Nomis)
meta.quality: Official statistics (ONS small-area population estimates, Census-2021 based, constrained to LA mid-year estimates, so LSOAs sum exactly to LA totals).
meta.limitations: Modelled from administrative data (GP registrations, child benefit, students) rolled forward from Census 2021; accuracy declines with time since the census and for LSOAs with student halls, care homes or new housing. Not rebased to any later census.
